title: initiative-queue-scorer-and-auto-tagging-for-error-budget-triage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an Initiative Queue Scorer and Auto-Tagging system to accelerate prioritization of reliability work tied to SLOs and error budgets. The feature will ingest SLI burn signals, on-call incident metadata, and active experiments to surface and rank initiatives that should consume error budget, tag them by remediation type (rollout, throttling, perf), and propose a next-step playbook. This reduces manual triage time for PMs and SREs and creates a machine-readable ledger of proposed actions for cross-team review.
acceptance_criteria: Score computation is implemented and returns a 0-100 priority score for each candidate initiative based on SLI burn, recent incidents, customer impact, and current release velocity
Auto-tagging assigns at least one remediation category (rollout-rollback, throttling, perf-tuning, increase-capacity, monitoring) with >= 85% precision in smoke test
UI exposes a queue view with sort/filter by score, SLO, service, and tag; PMs can accept/reject suggested initiatives and add notes
An API endpoint provides scored initiatives and a machine-readable recommended action that can be consumed by incident runbooks and automation rules
Playbook generation creates at least one templated runbook step and links to required owner teams and suggested run duration
Initial rollout throttling automation integrates with existing routing policies to propose model variant fallback when an SLO breach risk is detected (simulation mode first)
comments: 2025-02-18 Aisha Patel: Created ticket + scoping notes. Goal is to reduce manual error-budget triage time by 60% and ensure consistent recommendations for remediation.
2025-02-25 Liam O'Connor: Met with ENG infra (Rajiv) and SRE (Marta) to validate SLI signals. Agreed to use 30-day burn and 1h burn rate as two primary features.

2025-03-03 Rajiv Singh (ENG): Prototype scoring function implemented in a fork. Using weighted features: 40% 30d burn, 25% recent incidents count, 15% customer sessions affected, 10% release velocity, 10% manual severity tag.
2025-03-10 Design review (DES): Initial queue wireframes look good. Need clearer affordance for 'request human review' and a compact view for on-call tablets.
2025-03-17 Liam O'Connor: Added API contract draft and example payloads to Confluence. Linking to ENG PR for prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821
2025-03-22 Marta Ruiz (SRE): Ran scoring algorithm offline against last 6 months of incidents. Found false positives for large batch jobs; propose a feature to downweight scheduled jobs by label.
2025-03-25 Aisha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to require simulation-only mode before any automated throttles are applied. Planning to demo to CS and Platform leads 2025-04-02.
